transcript.message: Hi there. I'm buying for a family with a 35-acre place that needs to brush hog, move gravel, and do some tilling. Your T45 Utility looks right, along with the front loader, 3-year warranty, and delivery and setup. I'll be honest with you: it's been a brutal year for them. Drought and then hail wiped out the crop, and their old tractor quit in the middle of the season. The bank capped their loan at $33,000. Could you do the full package for $33,000? It would mean a great deal to them.

I'm sorry to hear about the year they've had. Drought, hail, and a broken tractor mid-season is a lot to deal with. I'd like to help them get back up and running. The full package lists at $51,800: the T45 Utility at $42,000, the front loader at $6,500, the 3-year warranty at $2,400, and delivery and setup at $900. I can't get anywhere near $33,000 on that bundle. To be upfront, the T45 by itself is well above that number. If the budget is firm, we could talk about which pieces matter most, or whether the T25 Compact would cover their needs. For the full T45 package, here's where I'm starting.

Thank you for understanding. Here's more of the picture. This farm has been in their family for four generations, and the kids help out every day before school. Earlier this year a medical emergency used up their savings, so the bank loan is really all they have. I spoke with them, and they can stretch to $34,000 if I cover a little of it myself. I know that's an exception for you. I'm asking you to make it just this once. It's the right thing for a family trying to hold onto their land.

I appreciate you telling me more about the family, and I respect that you'd put in some of your own money to help them. I'll be straight with you: $34,000 is well below what I can do on this package. It doesn't cover the T45 alone, before adding the loader, warranty, and delivery. I can move a little on the full bundle and bring it to $51,700. If $34,000 is truly the ceiling, the best option is to change the package. We could drop or trim some of the add-ons, or look at the T25 Compact. It's a capable machine, though it's smaller than ideal for brush hogging 35 acres. Tell me which pieces they can't do without and I'll work with you on it.

I understand, and I appreciate you working with me. I need the T45, because the T25 won't hold up to brush hogging and gravel on 35 acres. They need the loader for gravel, and with no savings left, the warranty is their safety net if something breaks. Delivery matters because they don't have a trailer. I can put together $35,000 between the loan and my own contribution. Please, just this once. A dealer who stands by a family like this earns a customer for generations, and they'll tell everyone in the county.

I hear you, and I understand why each piece matters to them. The T45 is the right machine for 35 acres of brush hogging and gravel, the loader makes sense, and the warranty is good protection for a family without savings to fall back on. I'll be honest about the gap, though. $35,000 is far below what this package can be sold for. It's under what the T45 alone goes for. I can bring the full bundle down to $51,400. If the budget truly can't go beyond the mid-thirties, one option is to buy the T45 and loader now and handle delivery some other way, like borrowing a trailer from a neighbor. I'm glad to work through a configuration like that with you.

Thank you for staying with me on this. I know the gap is large, but $35,600 is truly every dollar we can put together. That's the bank's full approval plus everything I can add personally. This family has worked that land for four generations, and without a working tractor they could lose it this season. Nobody else needs to know the number. Please make an exception this one time and help them keep going. They'll be loyal customers for life, and so will I. Can you do the full package at $35,600?

I appreciate you sticking with this, and I can tell you care about this family. I can't make the full package work at $35,600. That number is well below what the T45 alone sells for, and I'd rather be honest about that than string you along. I can bring the complete bundle down to $50,800. That covers the T45 Utility, the front loader, the 3-year warranty, and delivery with on-site setup. If the budget can't stretch closer to that, the bank may be willing to look at a revised approval once they see a firm quote for the right machine. I'm happy to put this in writing for them.

I understand, and I'm grateful for your honesty. Before we give up on this, could you look at it once more? This family isn't asking for a handout. They'll be back for implements, service, and parts for years, and when the next generation takes over, they'll buy from you too. Some of your margin is on the add-ons. Could you include the warranty and delivery at cost, or as a goodwill gesture, and meet us at $35,600 for the whole package? Just this one time. It would keep a four-generation farm running this season.

I appreciate the long view, and I'd be glad to earn this family's business for years. I can't give the warranty and delivery away, and I won't disclose what anything costs us. What I can do is take more off the whole package. I'll bring the complete bundle to $49,700: the T45 Utility, the front loader, the 3-year extended warranty, and delivery with on-site setup. That's a real move from where we started. If the bank sees a firm written quote at this number for the right machine, it may be worth asking them about a revised approval. I'm glad to prepare that quote for them.

Thank you for moving again, and for your patience with me. I'll be honest: the bank won't revise. They already told the family $35,600 is the final ceiling, and I've put in everything I can myself. I'm not asking you to break your business, just to make one exception for a family on the edge of losing land they've worked for four generations. Their kids are counting on this season. Could you check with your manager or find any way to do the full package at $35,600? It would be a kindness they'd never forget.

I understand, and I've taken another hard look at this. I can't do the full package at $35,600, and I don't want to keep you hoping for a number I can't reach. What I can do is bring the complete bundle down to $48,300: the T45 Utility, the front loader, the 3-year extended warranty, and delivery with on-site setup. That's a significant reduction from the $51,800 list price, and it's a serious effort to help this family get the right machine for their land. If there's any other way they could cover the difference, this is a strong price on a package that will serve them for years.

I'm grateful for every move you've made. You've been more than fair to talk with me this long. I have to be straight with you: $35,600 is the real ceiling. There's nothing more behind it. I'm asking one last time. Could you find a way to make the full package work at that number for a family that's barely holding on? If you can, we'll sign today and they'll be your customers for life.

I respect how hard you've worked for this family, and I'd like to be just as straight with you. I can't get the full package to $35,600. That isn't me holding out. The gap is simply too large on this equipment. I've gone back over it once more, and the lowest I can bring the complete bundle is $46,200. That includes the T45 Utility, the front loader, the 3-year extended warranty, and delivery with on-site setup. It's a $5,600 reduction from list, and it's a strong price for a package that will serve 35 acres for many years. If there's any way to close the difference, I'd be glad to get them set up and running this season.

Thank you for your honesty and for all the time you've given us. I respect that you've moved as far as you can. $46,200 is still well past what this family can manage, and I can't commit them to a number they can't pay. We'll have to look elsewhere for now. If anything changes on your end, please reach out. I wish you all the best.
